name: nsc-desktop
description: Naresh Saree Collection - Desktop Billing App
author: Naresh Saree Collection <info@nareshsareecollection.com>

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:backend" "wait-on http://localhost:3002/health && npm run start:electron"
scripts.build:frontend: cd ../Billing_Software_Frontend && npm run build -- --mode electron && cd ../NSC-Electron && npx shx rm -rf renderer && npx shx cp -r ../Billing_Software_Frontend/dist renderer
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --config electron-builder.config.js
